items.item:
0. The first publish of a type on a project makes version 1, `published`.
   Shows A07-2, A07-3. [witness: verification:registry_a07_first_publish_makes_version_one]
statements:
```text
for each project p and type t: count(pointer of p, t with status published) <= 1   -- A07-1
for each project p and type t: versions of p, t are 1..n without gaps or repeats   -- A07-2
publish(p, t) accepted => new.version = max(version of p, t) + 1 (or 1)   -- A07-3
publish(p, t) accepted => the previous published pointer of p, t becomes
superseded in the same transaction as the new one is stored   -- A07-4
```

verdicts.why: The selected test verifies that first publishes are version 1 and published, that versioning is scoped per project and type, and that a subsequent accepted publish receives version 2. The history assertion detects gaps or repeated versions in the resulting sequence, covering A07-2 and A07-3 for the exercised publishes.
